definitions.explanation: A piece of cloth with a distinctive design, used as a symbol.
A large piece of cloth bearing a message or design.

examples.english: The demonstrators marched through the streets holding up banners.

notes:
{旗|はた} refers to flags and banners. Used both literally and figuratively.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{国旗|こっき}→国旗：19216_kokki⟧: national flag
- ⟦{白旗|しらはた}→白旗：19398_shirahata⟧: white flag (surrender)
- ⟦{旗印|はたじるし}→旗印：27807_hatajirushi⟧: banner, slogan, rallying cry
- ⟦{赤旗|あかはた}→赤旗：28002_akahata⟧: red flag

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {旗|はた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to wave a flag
- {旗|はた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise a flag; to start a cause
- {旗|はた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げる→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧: to hoist a banner
- ⟦{旗色|はたいろ}→旗色：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: things look bad (idiom)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Japanese national flag is called ⟦{日の丸|ひのまる}→日の丸：19387_hinomaru⟧ (circle of the sun).
